schema_notes: Targeted version comparison. runs contains per-run analyses and complete derived distributions; comparison contains shared metric groups. This is not the full-suite v3 reading/library/network schema.

environment.device: RP-A; ESP32-S3 revision 0.2; 8 MiB PSRAM; 16 MiB flash

conditions.notes: git diff v0.5.1 2b0e98d and a2871cc HEAD over firmware/tools/boards is empty. Diagnostic variants are used on both sides.
conditions.cache: Entire forward/back path traversed by initial latest run before v051 and repeated latest paired runs; first warm-up open per book excluded; no disk-cold claim.
conditions.measurement: Host monotonic timestamp immediately before serial command to received Body frame completion notification; no status polling inside interval. Trace and status drained afterward.
conditions.comparability: Same physical device/TF, unchanged global settings, identical file bytes and 38 px settings; independent boots; initial latest warm-up followed by 0.5.1 and latest repeat. Asynchronous prefetch state was observed rather than fixed.
conditions.initial_run_role: Preserved initial validation and full-path disk-cache warm-up; excluded from paired table.

findings.conclusion: Both versions exhibit a complete, successful, slow chapter transition. No root cause or PR185 causal claim.
findings.description_zh: 章节较多的书在正文跨章时，两版均出现过等待数秒才完成正文刷新的情况。

findings.conclusion: The latest first transition had no prepared chapter in both runs; the baseline first transition did. The scheduling cause is unverified.

scope_clarification_zh: 报告中的「正文跨章翻页」是阅读正文时翻到上一章或下一章的操作，不包含目录列表翻页；本轮另行记录了开书和同章正文翻页。
